reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis invokes a crystalline-to-amorphous transformation (CA-TRIP) at FCC/BCC interfaces driven by elemental intermixing under sustained load, but this mechanism is speculative and lacks direct precedent in crystalline/crystalline HEA multilayers; the proposed diffusionless amorphization under creep conditions is physically questionable.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is well-structured with a clear comparison (engineered vs. sharp interfaces), specific in-situ measurements, and a decisive falsification criterion, though the practical feasibility of quantifying interfacial amorphization in situ during creep is challenging.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the core question of creep control in HEA multilayers with a novel, testable mechanism, but its low plausibility and reliance on an unproven transformation reduce its immediate value to researchers.
